ask: Pin this recipe photo to the same board as last week's lemon tart pin, linking to the recipe: https://cdn.example.com/fig-galette.jpg and https://acme.example.com/recipes/fig-galette

steps.why: The decision on the board: take it from the pin the user named. No tool lists boards, and with none set Bolta uses the most recently synced board, which may be wrong. This read shows the board as board_id, Pinterest's own id. If that board_id comes back empty, the earlier pin's board was set another way: check its metadata.platformSpecific.pinterest with get-post, else ask the user to pick the board in Bolta.

steps.why: One image, one pin, all in the saving call. platform_specific board_id takes Pinterest's id, exactly what the read gave (update-post-platform-details would want Bolta's own id instead, so the read's value never goes there). A title people would search, the recipe page as the link (a pin without one gets saves, not visits), and alt text, which Pinterest does receive.
Read back metadata.platformSpecific.pinterest: unknown keys and typos are kept quietly.
